banner.title: tuppr
banner.tagline: Rolls Talos and Kubernetes upgrades across the nodes from the versions pinned in Git, and waits while storage is busy.

art.about: an operator that rolls OS and Kubernetes upgrades across cluster nodes, gated on storage health
art.title: How tuppr rolls a Talos upgrade

explainer.title: A version bump in Git becomes a gated node roll

steps.title: Pin
steps.text: A version bump in the TalosUpgrade or KubernetesUpgrade CR is the upgrade. Renovate opens it as a pull request.
steps.scene: a pin on a blank card with abstract lines and no text

steps.title: Gate
steps.text: Before a node is touched, tuppr checks that no kopiur mover is running and that Ceph reports HEALTH_OK.
steps.scene: a gate with a Ceph hexagon and a mover icon

steps.title: Reboot
steps.text: The node is hard-reset with powercycle, then boots the new Talos image.
steps.scene: a server tower with a power symbol

steps.title: Wait
steps.text: A failing check is retried, not skipped. A stuck mover holds the roll until it finishes.
steps.scene: an hourglass over a stalled line

steps.title: Continue
steps.text: When the node is back and healthy, tuppr moves to the next one and the gates run again.
steps.scene: a row of healthy nodes with checkmarks
